prose: Crrow777 is a regular guy who's spent a lot of time behind a telescope, shooting the moon and other aerial objects. We talk about some of the discoveries he's made and filmed, we point out the obvious lies from NASA, internet censorship and free speech.
ext: We get into Spagyrics and Alchemy, and the great conjunction at the end of 2020, according to the Sky Clock.
